violations.description: General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Nonfood contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in a good repair or sound condition. Floor in dish area has excessive debris buildup under washing equipment and counters. Clean more regularly. Soda room has pooled up syrup underneath storage rack. Clean more regularly. Grease buildup on Chick-fil-a floors. Slippery.
